3.note: The worklist detail names the line-range proof and the template's exact forms without raising its word budget.

4.note: Read the persisted worklist and full memory-quality log together. A computed block reports state, path, digest and total item kinds, not proof that the items are answered; an absent block is neither pass nor empty. The gate separately reports pass/refused, owner, worklist identity and finding/open/incomplete/violation/report-only counts. Do not sum its subtotals into a verdict or count report-only observations as blockers; a changed pair needs its own check.
